text:
amal: FYI planning to narrow KMS Decrypt principals for EU/APAC tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Could impact older rotator SAs that unwrap certs for ptls. Any immediate concerns?

kevin: noted. My infra PR already removed legacy principals; I expect some unwrap fails if rotator identity wasn't rotated.

sam: we saw 5 unwrap failures in apac-staging after the iam rename. log: kms:DecryptAccessDenied principal=svc-rotator-apac

ops-oncall: incident-bot: alert 126 low-level unwrap failures in apac-staging last night, correlated to rotator.

amal: mitigation options: temporary conditional KMS binding OR quick rollback of principal change. Which is faster?

kevin: temporary binding with request.time < "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z" is fastest. I can apply and annotate with ticket.

sam: please add ROTATOR_REQ_ID env var for correlation in unwrap logs so we can map KMS audit entries to jobs.

audit-bot: audit-log: KMS policy change pending by kevin. remember to add expiration and ticket number.

amal: action items:
- kevin: apply conditional KMS decrypt grant + post ticket (ETA 10m)
- sam: add req_id to rotator unwrap logs and demo in staging (ETA EOD)
- ops-oncall: monitor ptls-client-cert-missing metric during window (ETA realtime)

kevin: applied binding at 2026-03-25T02:05Z with expiry 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z. ticket INFR-8892.

ops-oncall: incident-bot: unwrap failures dropped to zero post-change. ptls metrics stable.

amal: thanks. dylan will draft RBAC hardening playbook next for safe rollouts and audit schema. Keep follow-ups in this thread.
